Class Configuration

java.lang.Object
org.example.Model.Configuration
public class Configuration extends Object
Stores configuration values used by the airport simulation. The configuration contains random seed settings, arrival parameters, service time means and standard deviations, traversal parameters, scaling factors, probabilities, and scenario-specific service means. This class provides getter methods for reading configuration values and selected setter methods for updating simulation parameters.
